:param raw_data: should we return api response raw or wrap it with
                         Entity objects.
    """

    base_url: str
    api_version: str | None = "v1"
    retry: int | None = 3
    retry_wait: int | None = 30
    limit_codes: list[int] = [429]  # noqa: RUF012
    retry_codes: list[int] = [503, 504]  # noqa: RUF012
    auth_token: Callable | None = None
    access_token: str | None = None
    expires_in: int | None = None
    auth_header: str | None = None
    extra_headers: dict | None = None
    user_agent: str | None = None
    raw_data: bool | None = False
    allow_redirects: bool | None = False
    # Treat an HTML body as an error rather than handing the caller the raw
    # Response. Off by default: connectors share this client against third-party
    # APIs, and some tolerate a non-JSON reply on purpose.
    raise_on_html: bool = False
    auth_token_mode: str | None = "Bearer"
    verify: bool | str | None = None
    cookies: Any | None = None
    ttl_cache: int = 60
    # (connect, read) seconds. Default prevents indefinite hangs when a pooled
    # socket is silently severed (NAT/LB idle reaping). Override with None to
    # disable, or pass a single int to use the same value for both.
    timeout: int | tuple[int, int] | None = (10, 300)
    cert: str | tuple | None = None

[build-system]
requires = ["setuptools~=70.3.0"]
build-backend = "setuptools.build_meta"

# We will keep handling dependencies in setup.py
# since it helps us organize and isolate version management
[project]
name = "openmetadata-ingestion"
version = "2.0.0.0.dev0"
dynamic = ["readme", "dependencies", "optional-dependencies"]
authors = [
    { name = "OpenMetadata Committers" }
]
license = { file = "LICENSE" }
description = "Ingestion Framework for OpenMetadata"
requires-python = ">=3.10"

[project.urls]
Homepage = "https://open-metadata.org/"
Documentation = "https://docs.open-metadata.org/"
Source = "https://github.com/open-metadata/OpenMetadata"

[tool.setuptools.dynamic]
readme = { file = ["README.md"] }

findings: Lineage PUT authorizes both endpoints then returns empty200 after repository call.
Invalid column references are filtered by selected validator; re-read reconciliation required.
Entity timestamps use caller/prior/server fallback rules; not observation-availability proof.
Client3retries with30second increasing waits; transport errors raised, unexpected nonraw errors can returnNone; status/body semantics must remain explicit.
OpenLineage route checks enablement and uses a separate mapper/response; mapping and custom-facet retention remain uninspected.
Full generic schema compatibility remains unqualified because of Java-specific regex; local exercised schema fixtures pass with explicit scope.
